name: Algebraic Endpoint Load Disguise
description: Replaces the directed graph orientation and extreme indegree counts (0 and d_i) with an asymmetric power delivery model. Each edge assigns a large, non-obvious weight (3 and 8) to its endpoints. The per-vertex target sum is an algebraic expression of the degree and color that secretly forces all incident edges to provide the same weight, mathematically necessitating a bipartite coloring without using zero-counts or flow terminology. This defeats models that pattern-match "indegree 0" directly to bipartiteness.
